cards.title: The profile decides the screens
items: inventory.json: New appliance is a steps tile: room (choice), photo, plate (photo with ocr), note (text), then a review card (inventory.json 10–32).
Each step's screen comes from actions.js; the photo is a JPEG of at most 1280 px whose quality drops until it fits 1400 KB (actions.js 138–196). finish() sends one tile message (app.js 137–144).

cards.title: The flow
items: edge in (tile events) → which tile → inventory record (room, kind, plate text, note, both photos) → http request to $DHC_API/inventory (examples/inventory.json 13–30, 69–85).
answer the phone counts in flow context and sends a toast and the count's state through edge out (examples/inventory.json 107–109).

cards.title: Where the record lives
items: The edge keeps the event in memory only, for the setup page; the record belongs to DigitalHome.cloud. If the POST fails, the person is told, and nothing is retried.
